P1.source_conditions: Actual Figure1 physical p.1 visibly gives A or B, Not B, then Not A; caption describes application of logical rules and lower panel concludes Stockholm (A). Body text on that same page gives the correct P or Q, not Q therefore P.
P1.check: With B false the first premise requires A true, so the two premises have the unique assignment (A,B)=(true,false); Not A is false. Replacing only the conclusion by A is valid.
P1.counterevidence_severity_repair: The correct body and Table1 constrain this to a local introductory diagram, with no evidence of wrong benchmark labels. Minor is the upper supported impact of the explicit false symbolic illustration; no core theory or dataset allegation follows. A deliberate erroneous-output interpretation is possible only with missing explanation and conflicts with the present caption.

P2.source_conditions: Read physical p.23 AppendixH all-model range and actually viewed p.24 Table8 last condition. The stated population contains all seven models; no Phi-mini exclusion is present.
P2.check: The displayed last-condition paired scores are 28.72,44.66,69.12,56.19,40.09,31.27,31.92; minimum is 28.72 (Phi-mini), maximum 69.12 (Llama-3-8B). The 31.27 Gemma minimum is inconsistent.
P2.counterevidence_severity_repair: Minor secondary descriptive statistic only. Correct range is conditional on table authority; no raw measurement validation or changed central benchmark conclusion is established.

U1.source_conditions: Physical p.8 section6/Table3 uses one first-country-token score per city, reused over 600 pairs according to footnote19; Welch significance is stated without clustering implementation/sample degrees of freedom.
U1.check: Duplicating 4 scores per group 600 times preserves means but changes naive sample-size standard errors. Using original sample variance 1/60 and mean difference .1 gives t=sqrt(1.2)=1.09545; duplicated sample variance=.0125*2400/2399 gives t=sqrt(959.6)=30.9774. This independently verifies the failure mechanism.
U1.counterevidence_boundary: An undisclosed city-level/cluster-aware analysis could rescue actual inference. No actual naive implementation, corrected p-value, or absence of association is proved. Needs Evidence boundary is appropriate; grouped outcomes/analysis code are missing. Observational attention and familiarity analyses do not establish a causal mechanism.
